title_max_chars.quote: The property value has a maximum length of 100 characters

description_max_bytes.quote: The property value has a maximum length of 5000 bytes

forbidden_characters.note: Title and description accept all valid UTF-8 characters except < and >.

tags_max_chars.note: Commas between tags count; a tag containing a space counts as if wrapped in quotation marks.

privacy_status_values.note: If the API request omits it, videos.insert defaults to public. ReachWeaver never relies on a default.

made_for_kids_declaration.quote: Regardless of your location, we require you to tell us whether or not your videos are made for kids.
made_for_kids_declaration.note: The creator is legally responsible for the designation (COPPA).

altered_or_synthetic_disclosure.note: Lets the channel owner disclose realistic altered or synthetic content.

description_links.note: URLs in the description render as clickable links only when the channel meets platform-level requirements such as verification or Advanced Features.

api_upload_scopes.note: videos.insert accepts any one of these scopes.

unverified_project_private_lock.note: The 2020-07-28 revision-history entry says videos.insert uploads from unverified API projects created after 28 July 2020 are restricted to private viewing until an audit. The videos.insert page (last updated 2026-10-08) says such uploads are not restricted to private viewing mode. Treated as unknown. It concerns API uploads only, not uploads made by the owner in YouTube Studio. Sources: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videos/insert ; https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/revision_history

notice: MANUAL EXPORT ONLY. ReachWeaver has not sent, uploaded, scheduled or shared anything on YouTube. This package is not evidence that a post exists. The account holder decides whether to post it, in the platform's own app.
checklist: Verify every claim against its cited source (campaign-check / claims-check); this package does not prove anything is true.

Paste title.txt as the title and description.txt as the description, exactly.
Run media-check on the media you attach (alt text, captions, rights, limits).
Make each decision yourself in the native app: privacy_status, made_for_kids, altered_or_synthetic_content. Nothing is pre-selected.
Confirm rights, consent and disclosure for all text and media.
If you post it, copy the post's link from the app and keep it: that link is the proof the post exists. ReachWeaver records nothing from this package.
